planner_finish.summary: SOLVED in one episode (no reset), terminated==true at step 31. Task: "pick up the salad dressing and place it in the basket". (1) Localized the salad-dressing bottle (clear bottle, light-green label, dark-green cap) in agentview_high by label/shape, ruling out the ketchup bottle, tomato-sauce/alphabet-soup cans, cream cheese, milk; median back_project gave it lying on its side at (-0.028, 0.164); basket cavity from four rim pixels: x[-0.071,0.066], y[0.219,0.379], rim z~0.133. (2) Because the cylinder lay on its side, I skipped a text-prompt Pi0 pick and scripted it: rotate_wrist to yaw +90deg so the jaw closing axis matched the bottle's long axis, pre-positioned 15cm above, descended with jaws OPEN until the pads self-limited (eef z=0.030), closed -> gripper_qpos separation 0.035 (not shut) and wrist/agentview confirmed the bottle lifted clear. (3) Carried with gripper +1 in <=0.10m hops at z=0.24 to (-0.005,0.305), descended to eef z=0.164, released, retreated straight up. (4) The bottle perched on the liner folds (top z=0.204 > rim 0.133), predicate not fired. Two short closed-gripper presses stood it upright on the liner floor but its COM stayed marginal at the basket bbox top, so per the task-family memory's t2 guidance ("perched -> capped pi0_doubled with an explicit push-into-basket prompt") I called pi0_doubled("push the salad dressing bottle into the basket", max_chunks=12) which needed only 2 chunks and fired official termination with the bottle lying inside the liner cavity. Audit and recipe JSONL written to the output dir.
